proposal.expected_benefit: Improved resilience against real-world adversarial attacks by validating the defense strategies in more realistic conditions.
proposal.problem: The current strategy may lead to overconfidence in the system's security posture due to the absence of adversarial payloads in simulation-only scenarios.
proposal.proposed_change: Introduce controlled adversarial engagement in simulation-only scenarios to test the robustness of mitigation strategies against real-world attack vectors. This will ensure that the defense mechanisms are not only theoretically sound but also effective in practical scenarios.
proposal.title: Enhance Real-World Adversarial Engagement in Simulation Scenarios
verification_tests: Simulate adversarial payloads in controlled environments to validate the effectiveness of the mitigation strategies.
Evaluate the system's response to real-world attack vectors in simulation-only scenarios.
